title: Revit pre-issue style QA completeness
test_intent: Determine whether the declared Revit issue/review scope has completed the required style-focused QA checks for view graphics, sheet/view consistency, annotation/notation, and recorded evidence without misrepresenting the result as coordination sign-off or formal acceptance.

applicability.applies_when: A Revit view/sheet package is being prepared for formal issue or major internal review.
applicability.not_applicable_when: No Revit view/sheet package is in the tested issue/review scope.

required_evidence: applicable governed view/template, titleblock, naming, annotation/tagging, parameter, and output rules
recorded results for applicable pre-issue style checks
representative output evidence where plotted/visual legibility is material
deviation or exception records for unresolved findings

result_logic.pass: Every applicable style-focused pre-issue check has a recorded acceptable result or approved deviation, required evidence is present, and the QA record preserves the boundary between style QA and higher-level coordination/acceptance decisions.
result_logic.fail: One or more applicable checks fail without governed disposition, required evidence is missing, or the QA result is incorrectly represented as coordination sign-off or formal acceptance.
result_logic.not_applicable: No Revit view/sheet package is in the tested issue/review scope.
result_logic.indeterminate: The issue/review scope, governing rules, required check profile, or evidence record is unavailable or incomplete.

provenance.migration_note: Round 006 adds explicit conformance for the already-migrated Appendix E Revit style QA instruction.
